items.question: Which two providers offer the smart renting (free-floating car sharing) service in the UAE?
items.fact: Udrive and Yaldi provide smart renting car-sharing services

items.question: Are on-demand smart car rental vehicles in Abu Dhabi available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week?
items.gold: Yes, 24/7 on-demand vehicle rental is available in different areas across the emirate.
items.fact: Smart renting vehicles available 24/7 on-demand across emirate areas
